question: After VMem retrieval is fixed, is the memory consumer causally addressable and sufficient at the source-to-target-region level, and does wrong or conflicting memory justify calibrated subset/null consumption?
source_policy: Formal proceedings or official conference pages were preferred. Recent work without proceedings was retained only when an arXiv primary record and original PDF were available. Search snippets or assistant summaries alone were not used as scientific evidence.

excluded_or_rejected_claims.claim: A source-to-region change score is automatically causal benefit
excluded_or_rejected_claims.reason: Without frozen interventions it is association; without target ground truth it is sensitivity, not benefit.

retrieval_limit: This was a targeted 2024-2026 search, not a complete systematic review. The absence of an exact match does not establish novelty. A submission-level claim requires citation-network expansion, synonym search and independent verification.
